label: Current member
description: Say who this run is for. A run started by a member (through their own trigger copy, their member token, or the `Weft-Member` header on a gated route) fires `member` with their id; a run for nobody in particular (a cron, a manager route) fires `nobody` instead. Exactly one of the two fires, so each is a branch.

outputs.name: member
outputs.description: The member's id, the one your program uses for them (`user-42`). Fires only when the run is for a member.

outputs.name: nobody
outputs.description: True, and fires only when the run is for no member.
